name: ops/mandate-derive-widening-problem-valid
description: widening attempt rejection shape: a child asking for more than any parent fails the typed authority_widening problem (§10.2, §14.9, gap note G33)

problem.title: child mandate widens parent scope
problem.detail: derivation never widens (§10.2): the child requests destination sel-dest-anywhere not covered by any parent atom and an expiry later than the parent's; no new operation, resource, data class, destination, participant class, manifestation, ceiling, delegation depth/fanout, or weaker requirement can appear in a child
